prompt: You start with $\$15$ saved and add $\$5$ every week. Write an equation for your savings $y$ after $x$ weeks.
hint: Find the START (money at week $0$) and the MOVE (money added per week).

hints.text: Find the START (money at week $0$) and the MOVE (money added per week).
Start $b = 15$, move $m = 5$ per week. Fill in $y = mx + b$.

explanation: The start is $b = 15$ — the money before any weeks pass.
The move is $m = 5$ — dollars added each week.

alternativeExplanations.title: Test it on a week
steps: After $2$ weeks you should have $15 + 5 + 5 = 25$ dollars.
The equation says $y = 5 \times 2 + 15 = 25$. It matches, so it is right.

alternativeExplanations.title: From a table
steps: Week $0 \to 15$, week $1 \to 20$, week $2 \to 25$: a steady jump of $+5$.
The jump is $m = 5$; the week-zero value $15$ is $b$: $y = 5x + 15$.
